verdict.rationale: Mintlify's editor and Git-based workflow support PR-style review: preview URLs per pull request, comments/suggestions from the AI agent, and approve-and-merge from within the editor before publishing (mintlify-docs-12, mintlify-docs-17, mintlify-docs-25, mintlify-docs-26). This covers comments, preview/approval, and merge steps gating publication. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the review UI in practice, and explicit documentation of multi-reviewer approval gating (e.g., required approvers) beyond generic PR/merge mechanics.
